mentions.name: Curated LinkedIn topics + AI drafting
mentions.description: A weekly curation service that emails professionals 5-7 curated LinkedIn writing topics (tech trends, policy shifts, market movements), each with sources, multiple angles, and context. The user picks a perspective and AI drafts a polished article, pairing human editorial curation with AI-powered writing. Currently validating demand before building.
mentions.problem: Professionals who want to write on LinkedIn struggle with knowing what's worth writing about; in the AI era execution is commoditized and the real bottleneck is editorial judgment — knowing what topics matter before they're obvious. The hard part is systematizing trend-spotting and curation without losing signal quality.
mentions.audience: Professionals who should be building thought leadership on LinkedIn but don't have time to spend on research (~30M target market).
